artworks.title: Cardinal Jules Mazarin
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed within plate mark): 35.7 x 24.2 cm (14 1/16 x 9 1/2 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows a man's upper body, turned slightly to his left with his head facing forward. He has a mustache and goatee, medium-length wavy hair framing his face. He is dressed in a dark garment with a frequent button closure and a white collar extending outward. There is a piece of fabric around his neck. The background features fine lines radiating in an oval shape around the portrait. Below the portrait is an illustrated shield with heraldic symbols and foliage motifs against a lightly textured background.

artworks.title: Louis XIV
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed within plate mark): 20.1 x 13.4 cm (7 15/16 x 5 1/4 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows an individual seated on a platform holding an open book titled "CODE LOUIS XIV" and "Premiere Partie." They have curly hair and are dressed in a robe with fleur-de-lis patterns. The person is holding a pair of scales and there is a sculpted lion nearby with the words "IVSTITIAE INICIO DEBO" inscribed on a pedestal. In the background are vertical drapes.

artworks.title: Allegory in Honor of Anne of Austria
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 24.7 x 35.5 cm (9 3/4 x 14 in.)
artworks.description: The image depicts a woman holding a shield with a man's face on it. She sits on the ground, facing right, with her head turned towards the shield. She wears draped clothing, her hair is tied back, and she does not wear any visible jewelry. In the background are a large urn on a base, tall trees, and a frieze with relief figures. The scene is monochromatic with detailed line work.

artworks.title: Henri de Savoie, Duc de Nemours
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed within plate mark): 35 x 22.4 cm (13 3/4 x 8 13/16 in.)
artworks.description: The image is a portrait engraving showing the upper body of a young person facing left. Their facial features display a rounded face with medium-length, wavy hair. They wear a garment with a large, white, pointed collar over a dark fabric with intricate details. A cross-shaped adornment is on the chest. The background is plain, and the portrait is framed in an oval. Below the frame, there is an emblem with a monogram and a crown against a linear background.

artworks.title: Armand de Bourbon, Prince de Condi
artworks.description: The image shows the upper half of a young male figure seated or angled slightly, facing forward with his head turned to his left. He has a youthful face with prominent eyes, a subtle mouth, and curly hair reaching his collar. He is dressed in a garment with a voluminous collar and a decorative element, possibly a brooch. There is no visible jewelry or objects held. The background includes an oval frame with linear texture shading around the figure, and inscription details on the outer border.

artworks.title: Armand de Bourbon, Prince de Condi
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed within plate mark): 35.1 x 24.5 cm (13 13/16 x 9 5/8 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows an engraved portrait of a young person from the waist up. The individual is positioned slightly turned to the left but looking directly at the viewer. They have defined features, soft eyes, and curly hair that frames the face, reaching almost to the shoulders. The person is wearing a period-style outfit with a large white collar over a dark garment, fastened with a neck brooch. The clothing appears to be formal and is detailed with textures akin to rich fabric, such as velvet or silk. The portrait is set within an oval frame, accompanied by a coat of arms and initials "AD" below. The background features lined etching work that fills the space within the oval and extends onto the rest of the page.

artworks.title: Nicolas Grillet
artworks.description: The image shows an engraved portrait of a man in an oval frame. He is facing towards the left with his head slightly turned towards the viewer. The man has curly hair, arched eyebrows, and wears a robe with a crucifix around his neck. The background features a lined pattern within the oval frame and a plain border. Below the portrait is a coat of arms with a shield and a hat with tassels, all in an engraved style.

artworks.title: Nicolas Ysambert
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of an elderly man. He has wrinkle on his face, a short white beard and a hat with flaps. He is wearing a high-collared shirt and a garment with puffed sleeves. The background has vertical and circular lines, and below the portrait are decorative scrolls with inscriptions.

artworks.title: J.-B. A. Vignerod
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed within plate mark): 33.1 x 23.6 cm (13 1/16 x 9 5/16 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows a close-up portrait of an individual from the waist up. The person has curly hair, a straight nose, and slightly parted lips. They wear a garment with a wide collar and a tassel, as well as a cloak over their shoulders. The individual holds an object, potentially a ruler or measuring tool, in one hand. Objects like books and a globe are placed around them, indicating a scholarly theme. The background has ornate details framing the oval-shaped portrait.

artworks.title: Barthelemy Tremblay
artworks.medium: engraving on laid paper; laid down
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 27 x 19.6 cm (10 5/8 x 7 11/16 in.)
artworks.description: The engraving shows an oval portrait of a man facing the viewer in three-quarter view. The man has facial hair and short white hair. He wears a dark coat with a white collar. The portrait is surrounded by an ornate architectural frame with decorative elements, including foliage, scrolls, and symmetrical designs. Classical motifs are present in the background, along with a skull above a cross, clouds, and a plaque with French text.

artworks.title: Jean Saint Bonnet de Toiras
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed within plate mark): 32.7 x 21.9 cm (12 7/8 x 8 5/8 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows a man from the waist up in a classic portrait pose. He is slightly turned to his left, with his face angled towards the viewer. The man's facial features include a slightly rounded face with strong cheekbones and a firm jawline, along with a short, slightly pointed nose. His hair is curly and falls to just above his shoulders in defined waves. He is dressed in ornate armor featuring rivets and decorative elements, with a sash draped diagonally across his chest. A cross-shaped insignia hangs from his neck. The background is an oval frame, and below it is a decorative element with a coat of arms or similar insignia, flanked by lion figures.

artworks.title: Jacques Thubeuf
artworks.artist: Michel Lasne after Philippe de Champaigne
artworks.description: The image depicts the upper three-quarters of a man's body. He has curly hair that extends to his shoulders and a neatly trimmed beard and mustache. His facial expression is neutral, and he has a prominent forehead and arched eyebrows. The man is wearing a high-collared white shirt under a dark robe or coat with wide sleeves, fastened with several small buttons. He has one hand resting on a stack of books on a table, while the other is positioned over his chest. A bracelet or cuff decorates his wrist. In the background, there is a draped cloth or curtain. In the lower portion of the image, there's an inscription and a crest or coat of arms.

artworks.title: Nicolas Brulart
artworks.description: The image depicts a detailed portrait of a man facing forward. He has a pronounced nose, deep-set eyes, high cheekbones, a full beard, and neatly combed hair. He is dressed in formal attire with a fur-lined cloak. In the background, there is a textured pattern and a small plaque above his left shoulder. The caption identifies him as Messire Nicolas Brulart Chevallier Seigneur de Sillery, Chancellor of France and Navarre.

artworks.title: Pierre Seguier
artworks.description: The image shows an engraving of a man from the waist up. He is facing slightly to the left with his head turned towards the viewer. The man has a long nose, a pointed goatee, arched eyebrows, deep-set eyes, curly hair, and is dressed in historical attire with an elaborate vest and wide white collar. There are decorative elements around him, including scrolls and a heraldry cartouche at the bottom. The background has subtle shading for depth.

artworks.title: Pierre Seguier
artworks.medium: engraving on laid paper; laid down
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed within plate mark): 29.2 x 20.5 cm (11 1/2 x 8 1/16 in.)
artworks.description: The image is an engraved portrait of a man named PETRVS SEGVIER. He is depicted from the upper half of his body facing slightly left but looking forward, with a subtle smile. He has a defined mustache and beard, curly shoulder-length hair, and is dressed in formal attire with a white collar, dark garment, and decorative buttons. The ornate frame surrounding him features inscriptions, including his name, and a coat of arms at the bottom. The background consists of engraved lines.

artworks.title: Pierre de Ronsard
artworks.description: The image depicts an engraving of a man's upper body in profile, facing right. The man has distinct facial features including a prominent nose, strong chin, a beard, short curly hair, and a laurel wreath on his head. He is wearing a draped toga-like garment secured by a brooch on his shoulder. There are no visible jewelry pieces. The background is plain with engraving lines, enclosed in an oval border with decorative elements at the top. The text "MYRTO ET LAURO" is seen above, and the bottom identifies the man as Pierre de Ronsard with additional French text. The entire portrait has an aged appearance typical of historical engravings.

artworks.title: Armand Jean du Plessis, Cardinal Richelieu
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a person with a distinguished appearance. They are positioned slightly to the side with their head turned toward the viewer. The person has a slender face, a pointed beard, mustache, and long, light hair falling to about the collar. They wear a clerical robe with a broad, white, pointed collar and a necklace with a large, ornate pendant resembling a star. The background is a textured, shaded surface resembling draped fabric. The portrait is surrounded by an ornate frame with a repeating pattern.

artworks.title: Armand Jean du Plessis, Cardinal Richelieu
artworks.description: The image is an engraving of a man with sharp facial features, including a narrow nose and a pointy chin. He has a trimmed mustache and goatee, curly hair cropped around the ears, and a tall cap with a prominent peak. He wears a robe with a large collar and buttons down the front. The background has textured lines forming an oval frame, with a description of the subject's name and titles below.

artworks.title: François La Rochefoucauld
artworks.description: The image shows a bust-length portrait of a man facing forward. He has a prominent brow, piercing eyes, a pointed beard with a mustache, and his hair is covered by a pointed cap. The man is wearing a robe with a wide collar and intricate button details, along with an elaborate necklace. The background features a textured pattern.

artworks.title: Armand Jean du Plessis, Cardinal Richelieu
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed within plate mark): 23.7 x 17.5 cm (9 5/16 x 6 7/8 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows a man seated in an ornate high-backed chair. He is facing forward with both arms on the armrests. The man has distinct facial features, including a pointed beard and mustache, with styled, curly hair. He is wearing a hat and ecclesiastical robes with intricate details. The background displays draped curtains. The chair has classical designs.

artworks.title: Armand Jean du Plessis, Cardinal Richelieu
artworks.medium: engraving on laid paper; laid down
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed within plate mark): 19.9 x 14 cm (7 13/16 x 5 1/2 in.)
artworks.description: This is a portrait of a man depicted from the upper body, slightly turned to the right. He has a defined face with high cheekbones, a pointed goatee, and a mustache. His hair is medium length, wavy, and parted down the middle. He wears a skullcap and is dressed in elaborate clothing with a wide stiff collar, a patterned garment, and a medal with a decorative cross around his neck. The portrait is framed by an ornate oval wreath, and below it, there is a scroll with the inscription "SEMPER IDEM." Surrounding the frame are decorative elements, including two books on either side and a rolled paper.

artworks.title: François La Rochefoucauld
artworks.medium: engraving on laid paper; laid down
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed within plate mark): 4.3 x 4.5 cm (1 11/16 x 1 3/4 in.)
artworks.description: The image is an engraving featuring the head and upper torso of a man named Cardinal Rupifucald. The man is facing slightly to the right with detailed facial features, a beard, a mustache, deep-set eyes, and a furrowed brow. He is wearing religious attire, including a cape and a high-collared garment with a cross insignia. The background is plain with a circular border framing the cardinal.

artworks.title: François La Rochefoucauld
artworks.description: The image shows a man from the waist up facing forward with his head slightly turned to the left. He has distinct facial features including a prominent brow, deep-set eyes, wide nose, and a subtle smile with a neatly trimmed mustache and small beard. He has somewhat curly hair under a squared cap. The man is wearing priestly attire, including a high-collared shirt, buttoned garment, and cloak. He has a chain around his neck with a large cross-shaped medallion. The background is plain, and the image is enclosed in an oval frame.

artworks.title: N. Paget
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a man in a seated position. He is facing slightly to his right, with a calm expression. The man has a mustache, goatee, curly hair, and is wearing dark formal attire with a white collar. The background features an oval frame with a coat of arms below the portrait.
